tabs.label: Delegate SMS
tabs.note: Make it opt-in, send once, and only fall back to your own gateway after VuloMail returns a WP_Error. Check readiness at send time, not at load.

tabs.label: Send email
tabs.note: Plain wp_mail() is already routed through VuloMail. Use this only for your plugin's name in the log and the real error back.

tabs.label: Add a provider
tabs.note: Adapters must never throw and never put a credential in an error. HttpClient::post() only allows HTTPS and never follows redirects. The connection form is generated from definition(): no JavaScript needed.

tabs.label: Add an alert
tabs.note: Set requires to 'woocommerce' (and available accordingly) to have the admin lock your alert when WooCommerce is missing.

tabs.label: Report in Diagnostics
tabs.note: VuloMail ships no checks for other plugins. Add your own row so site owners can see whether your plugin delivers through VuloMail, and why not.
